program_or_activity: Risk Management Agency Federal Crop Insurance Corporation

component_decision.component: disclosed sampling governance and design attributes
component_decision.basis: Official sources jointly disclose the 326-policy FY2024 review sample from reinsurance year 2022, AIP-aware selection, high/medium/low AIP tiers, a statistically valid designation, and independent audit review of USDA samples and underlying sampling methodologies.

full_sample_design_residuals: tier allocation and tier-level sample counts

governance_boundary.other_matters_item: The auditor encouraged OCFO to perform more detailed reviews of Sampling and Estimation Methodology Plans and inquire about potential inconsistencies.
governance_boundary.interpretation: Independent audit review and reported PIIA compliance establish governance review, not public methodological reproducibility.

evidence_boundaries: The component closure covers only the disclosed sample count, period label, AIP-aware selection, tier labels, statistical-validity designation, and independent-review governance.
The performance audit reviewed USDA samples and underlying sampling methodologies but does not publish the FCIC methodology materials it inspected.
Reported PIIA compliance does not establish that an outside reader can reproduce FCIC sample selection or projection.
Printed page 23 expressly encourages more detailed OCFO review of Sampling and Estimation Methodology Plans.
Full sample design remains open because frame, allocation, probabilities, randomization, replacement, nonresponse, weights, estimator, and variance details remain unpublished.
Nothing in the sources establishes fraud, waste, identified debt, collectibility, recovery, prevention, control cost, or savings.
